quest.title: Days Beneath the Waves
quest.description: Yves, a diver from Fontaine, seems to be busy...

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: Phew... Seriously... What awful luck...

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: That's right. I mean, I'm wearing my divesuit, aren't I? Anyway, do you need some sort of help?

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: If that's the case, I'm afraid you're out of luck... I won't be diving anywhere — not for the time being, anyway.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: The waters here are too complicated a maze. Dive even a little deeper, and not only will the current be enormously chaotic, but waterweeds and trash in their swarm will eagerly seize me by the legs.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: All it took was a moment of distraction, and a piece of metal had pierced my divesuit, causing it to leak.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: Fortunately, I wasn't far from shore, and even then it was a life-and-death game I played to get my feet back on dry land. The dive suit was damaged, but thankfully, my leg is mostly fine... I haven't much Mora for medical consultation.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: But I don't think I'll be able to finish the work that Goldman's assigned. In fact, I might even need to pay that stingy fellow. What luck, huh?

choices.text: It's good that you're safe, though.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: Quite the consoling figure you cut... But you're not wrong. Apart from my healthy body, I haven't anything else on my person.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: *sigh* Anyway, I won't be able to help you much. I need to get this divesuit patched up and continue trawling underwater trash for Goldman...

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: Thanks for your kindness, but diving isn't something just anyone can do. Besides, I don't even have much Mora to pay you with.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: #*sigh* Alright, alright. This hole is indeed too large for me to fix immediately, so I can only rely on your help, good {M#sir}{F#lady}.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: You've got a good heart. I've hardly any doubt that you must be beloved by all.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: That greedy greaseball Goldman always sends us the worst jobs — if the things he wants found aren't lost in the deepest waters, they're buried underground...

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: Let me mark the necessary locations for you one by one...

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: Alright, I've marked the various locations out. I'm counting on you, alright? Ugh, I can't believe the divesuit's this badly damaged... How much Mora will I have to fork out?

choices.text: Don't worry, I can do this.
Why don't I help you perform some salvage?

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: Him? Hmph, he's my boss — a specialist in hiring folks like me with no skills, but plenty of strength to spare in order to make ends meet.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: A real Fonta-for-brains he is, and he's strict and stingy to boot! He insists that we stick to that big, thick work manual while at work...

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: Also, even the divesuits we use at work are stuff he "rents" out to us.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: If we violate those stipulations or our divesuits get damaged, we'll have to pay him instead...

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: In other words, if I get careless at work even once, not only will I need to pay him a fee, but I'll need to grovel and beg him to keep me on staff! Pah!

choices.text: Did you just finish your dive?

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: That rapacious rogue...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's your divesuit?

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you! Sight for sore eyes, you are — best I've seen all day.

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: I'm sure you don't know what fresh new torture Goldman cooked up for us...

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: He hired some number cruncher, real calculating sort, to figure out how many objects each of us can salvage each day.

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: Then he forced us to haul salvage ashore based on these calculations!

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: But I mean, we get tired, get injured, grow hungry, and sometimes we just don't have energy. We can't simply haul that much out every single time. But does Goldman care? No!

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: If we can't match that quota, he scolds us and even docks our pay!

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: Not that this is the bean counter's fault. He's a good fellow named Finnegan, a real sympathetic type.

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: While he was doing his calculations, he would consult us regarding our daily work. One day, when he'd finished hearing what we had to say and done his sums...

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: He then stood up all of a sudden, ran into Goldman's house, and began yelling at that rogue.

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: I heard him say "...This is unreasonable — they're people, not machines!"

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: ...He wound up being thrown out by Goldman's underlings and fell into a puddle. We had to help him up and out of it.

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: How the fellow apologized — wept, even. I couldn't blame him, none of us could. He's one of Goldman's victims just like us.

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: He promised that he'd think of some way to help us get justice... But really, we all hope he never comes back to this cesspit.

choices.text: How much longer do you still have to work today?

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: A ton, I'm afraid. Can't say when I'll be done either. Just gotta do as much as I can, and hope I don't get docked too much Mora... All I can do is find someone to lend me a divesuit so I can work.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: Really? You'd still help me out?

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: You... really are my savior. If only that Goldman had half your good heart! ... Oh, no. I'm so sorry, I shouldn't even have compared that boorish boar to you.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: As before, I'll mark the location of the objects for you, then we'll split up and search. *sigh* I'm done for if I damage this borrowed divesuit, too...

choices.text: How much work have you got left today?

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: These are... What are all these trinkets? Are these what Goldman really wanted us to salvage?

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: Thanks so much for your help! Here... Take this Mora, and don't tell a soul about this.

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: If I could sell these, I can purchase a divesuit of my own. No longer would I need to rent from that Goldman!

choices.text: I can't take this from you.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: No, no! This is the wages you deserve. I know this is nothing compared to the effort you had to put in, but it's all I have left. I was planning to get a swig of booze with it tonight...

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: So please, take it. I'll take care of a few things, and then I'll figure out how to... y'know, sell this on the sly...

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: Have you helped me salvage those things?

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: That's right, this is what we go trawling for every day. It's just junk, junk, and more junk... Maybe that stingy rogue Goldman eats the stuff...

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help. This is the pay I got as an advance from Goldman — please take it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can't take this from you.

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: But you must! It's your wages for YOUR work. It no longer belongs to me... and if you won't take it, I'm just going to consign this coin pouch to the waters.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, alright...

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: That's the way! If you need anything salvaged in the future, come look for me. I'll get it out for you in one piece, no matter what it is!

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: But for now, I've got to continue repairing my divesuit. *sigh* Isn't this hole a little too big...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you get in trouble again?

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: Pah, that stingy rogue!

choices.text: Could you tell me about Goldman again?

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: He's my boss — real specialist in hiring folks like me with no skills, but strength to spare in order to make ends meet.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: A real Fonta-for-brains he is, and he's strict and stingy to boot! He insists that we stick to that big, thick work manual while at work...

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: Also, even the divesuits we use at work are stuff he "rents" out to us.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: If we violate those stipulations or our divesuits get damaged, we'll have to pay him instead...

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: In other words, if I get careless at work even once, not only will I need to pay him a fee, but I'll need to grovel and beg him to keep me on staff! Pah!

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: What do you want to know more about him for, anyways? I'm begging you, please, keep your distance from him — even if it's just for your good name's sake!

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: Shameless, that's what he is, and he surrounds himself with some of like kind to him, too. Bad eggs, them.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: Don't associate with that fellow — you'd not clean that mud and filth off your hands, not even with a tower's worth of pure water.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: But see, it takes nary any effort to stain a clear pond using dirty mud.

choices.text: You do some really hard work...

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: Hah, and isn't that the truth? But this is the only way I can make a living. I'm not smart, and I don't have any other skills, but I'm not going to turn to crime, either.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: If I must do evil to get the bread, then I'd rather go hungry!

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: My lot's rough, yes, but I can close my eyes in peace at night. No need to fear if anyone hates me, or might shank me in my sleep.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: If you think about it that way, my life's way better than Goldman's.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: #Sure. I'll leave the salvage work to you, good {M#sir}{F#lady}. As for me, I'm going to continue repairing that divesuit of mine...

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: Agh, what terrible luck...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Were you able to sell the stuff?

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. Ugh, forget it. I'd just found a buyer too, and that was when Goldman barged into my house and seized that box of trinkets!

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: If he didn't still need me to work for him, I'd have taken a real beating, too... He did deduct two months' salary, though...

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: He wants to pay me only after I've finished this whole year's worth of work.

dialogues.speaker: Yves
dialogues.text: *sigh* Forget it. Luck doesn't smile on idiots like me... Wait. Goldman didn't come knocking at your door, did he?

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: Good, then. Me getting beat up? Totally fine. But I would never want to get you in trouble with him.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: I didn't tell him about your salvage work, but I suspect that someone else found out and told him...

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: Still, I will need your help today again. My divesuit still hasn't been fixed, but Goldman's been pushing me to make up for the days where I was unable to finish work...

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: I had no choice but to borrow someone else's divesuit, but even so, I couldn't finish my work quickly enough... Unfortunately, I'm gonna have to rely on your goodwill again.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: Thank you. I'll mark the locations of the objects in question for you — we'll split up and search... I'll go repair that divesuit of mine after the work is done.

choices.text: If he did come to me, I'd have a lesson to teach him.

response.speaker: Yves
response.text: Please, don't get involved with that shameless lump of lard! Someone as honorable as yourself shouldn't even be acquainted with him!
